reproduction_environment.source_installation: No package build or installation; exact upstream source imported via PYTHONPATH=src
reproduction_environment.network_dependencies: GitHub source clone at exact commits; pinned public dataset download occurs in separate extraction venv and is not part of the Dishka test environment

dataset_extraction_environment.role: Extract one exact Parquet row and FAIL_TO_PASS metadata only; does not execute upstream Dishka code

reproducibility_limit: GitHub-hosted runner image is not a bit-for-bit immutable VM; OS release, kernel, Python version, commit IDs, source hashes, and raw test logs are recorded for this run.
